rationale: Typed ODE system inherited verbatim from the upstream contract. Parameters chosen at ecologically realistic magnitudes: intrinsic prey growth O(1)/time, K=100 with IC R=40 placing prey mid-range, moderate attack rate and handling time yielding a Type-II saturating functional response, small nonzero interference for Beddington–DeAngelis, conversion efficiency 0.4 and predator death rate 0.3 to keep both species persisting. refuge_fraction=0.5 lies inside the suggested [0,1] band and makes the new refuge modulation strongly visible on the R trajectory (~196x sigma). Time window 0–100 with 400 samples captures multiple oscillation periods without excessive stiffness. Noise sigma=0.5 is small relative to R excursions (tens of units) yet large enough to make excitation a meaningful test.
